title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Dominicus, VI Īd. Nov. (Sun 8 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra 3–21° and sunny; the RBA's fifth rate rise (4.85%, an 18-year high) and Angus Taylor: 'homegrown' inflation; US midterms: Republicans lose both houses, Stephen Miller new chief of staff, Hegseth under fire; Iran's offer via Qatar, tankers hit mines in Hormuz; Karl Bushby home after 28 years on foot; Opīniō: Judith Sloan on Labor's $560m grants; Nerva born, AD 30. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (4 Nov); The Spectator Australia; Yahoo News (6 Nov); Times of Israel (6 Nov); ITV News (2 Nov).

title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Lūnae, V Īd. Nov. (Mon 9 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra 2–21° and mostly sunny, 25° tomorrow; Australia's economy slows: 4.85% cash rate, 3.6% core inflation, Angus Taylor: 'you don't punish growth', Chalmers seeks productivity ideas; Iran: US Task Force Iron Gate targets land routes, 147 ships turned back; US: Senate counts in Mississippi and Alaska, Massie moves to impeach Hegseth; Ukraine: Russia hits the power grid, talks set for Abu Dhabi; Corvo island turns off its lights for seabirds; Opīniō: Rowan Dean on progressive antisemitism and the Segal report; the Lateran Basilica dedicated, AD 324. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology via WillyWeather; The Spectator Australia (Tony Nikolic, Rowan Dean); ABC News (6 Nov); Fox News and CBS News (7–8 Nov); Yahoo News (7 Nov); Kyiv Independent (8 Nov); Good Good Good (7 Nov).

title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Mārtis, IV Īd. Nov. (Tue 10 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra: fog, then 4–25° and mostly sunny; 28° and a chance of storms tomorrow. Australia: inflation 4.3%, Murray Watt tells colleagues to stop leaking against Chalmers, $3bn over-65s rebate cut stuck in the Senate, Resolve: only 20% trust Albanese, Taylor: 'out of touch, out of his depth'. Iran: Trump says Iron Gate is in full force, 'very little gets into, or out of, Iran'; Rubio calls Iran's offer 'outrageous and ridiculous'. US: House may vote to impeach Hegseth this week, Jeffries: 'Hegseth has got to go'; Mississippi postal votes close today. Ukraine: US-brokered talks open in Abu Dhabi after strikes on the grid. Flint, Michigan: newborn deaths halve under Rx Kids. Opīniō: David Flint, 'Australians have given up on Albanese'. Pope Leo the Great died, AD 461. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; ABC News (9 Nov); The Age/SMH (9 Nov); The National and Al Jazeera (9 Nov); Just Security (9 Nov); Roll Call (9 Nov); Yahoo News (7 Nov); UN News (9 Nov); Reuters (2 Nov); Good Good Good (7 Nov); The Spectator Australia (David Flint, 31 Oct).

title: Ācta Diurna · Diēs Mercuriī, III Īd. Nov. (Wed 11 Nov 2026)
summary: Canberra: 9–28°, partly cloudy, afternoon storm chance; 11–27° and morning fog tomorrow; Brisbane storms, 31°. Australia: Albanese flies to COP31 in Turkey on a two-week trip; Taylor: 'this government has wrecked the economy'; Charlton backs Chalmers; Newspoll: One Nation 28%, Labor 27%. Iran: Trump: Iran 'militarily, is effectively over' but America is 'locked and loaded', another carrier heads east; Rezaei: 'surrender to Iran's seven conditions'. US: House votes on Massie's Hegseth impeachment resolution; Hegseth: 'a political spectacle'. Ukraine: Abu Dhabi talks open, first in nine months; Russia fired 162 drones overnight. Brisbane: rescuer frees a koala joey from a python. Opīniō: Rowan Dean, Trump fought Iran because it was right. St Martin of Tours; Armistice 1918. Every line in English, then Latin; then all the Latin again. Sources: Bureau of Meteorology; AAP (Canberra Times, Armidale Express, 10 Nov); The Nightly (10 Nov); Israel Hayom, The Week (10 Nov); Fox News (9–10 Nov); ANI (10 Nov); ABC News US (10 Nov); Kyiv Independent (10 Nov); Epoch Times (10 Nov); ABC News (6 Nov); The Spectator Australia (Rowan Dean, 9 Nov).
